rationale: PURR gapped up 13% on no news catalyst, opened at $11.28, and has already sold off sharply to $10.90 — sitting at just 7.7% of today's range with price well below VWAP ($11.08) and the 9-EMA ($11.28), indicating distribution pressure. The last two 1-minute candles show heavy volume (1.35M shares in two minutes) with a decisive downward move, but price is now only 0.37% above the session low, making a long risky near support that could break, and a short risky given potential for a low-of-day bounce. With no news to explain the gap and the stock in freefall from the open, the risk/reward in either direction is unclear at this moment; waiting for price to either stabilize at the low or break it with confirmation is the prudent approach.
